gloss: to expose; to reveal; to disclose

definitions.gloss: to expose; to reveal; to disclose; to unmask
definitions.explanation: To bring hidden or secret information to light, especially wrongdoing, scandals, or things someone wanted to keep secret. Often implies the revelation is damaging to the person exposed.

examples.japanese: {不正|ふせい}が{暴露|ばくろ}された。
{元社員|もとしゃいん}が{会社|かいしゃ}の{内部|ないぶ}{情報|じょうほう}を{暴露|ばくろ}した。
examples.english: A former employee exposed the company's internal information.

examples.japanese: ネットで{有名人|ゆうめいじん}の{私生活|しせいかつ}が{暴露|ばくろ}されることが{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Cases of celebrities' private lives being exposed online are increasing.

notes:
USAGE:
Also used as a noun: {暴露|ばくろ} (exposure, revelation). The compound {暴露|ばくろ}{本|ぼん} (exposé book) is a common collocation. Carries a stronger, more dramatic tone than {明|あ}かす or {公開|こうかい}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秘密|ひみつ}を{暴露|ばくろ}する (to expose a secret)
- {不正|ふせい}を{暴露|ばくろ}する (to expose wrongdoing)
- {暴露|ばくろ}{本|ぼん} (exposé; tell-all book)
- {暴露|ばくろ}{記事|きじ} (exposé article)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {明|あ}かす: to reveal, to disclose — more neutral; can be used for personal confessions
- {告発|こくはつ}する: to accuse, to report — focuses on formally reporting wrongdoing, often to authorities
